      Motorola Edge 50 Fusion tG (Forest Green, 12GB RAM + 256GB Storage)

      Product description

      The Motorola Edge 50 Fusion in Forest Green with 12GB RAM and 256GB storage is a mid-range 5G smartphone combining stylish design with advanced features. It offers a smooth user experience thanks to its 144Hz pOLED display, a dual-camera system with a high-resolution Sony sensor, and reliable performance. Key specifications Display: 6.7-inch Full HD+ (2400 x 1080) Endless Edge pOLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate, HDR10+ support, and Corning Gorilla Glass 5 protection. It also features a peak brightness of 1600 nits and Pantone-validated colors. Processor: Qualcomm Snapdragon 7s Gen 2 octa-core processor. Memory and storage: 12GB of RAM and 256GB of non-expandable internal storage. Rear cameras: A dual-camera system. 50MP main camera featuring a Sony LYT-700C sensor with an f/1.8 aperture and Optical Image Stabilization (OIS). 13MP ultrawide + macro camera with a 120° field of view and autofocus. Front camera: A 32MP selfie camera with autofocus. Battery and charging: A 5000mAh battery that supports 68W TurboPower fast charging. The 68W charger is included in the box. Design: The Forest Green version features a vegan leather back and an IP68 rating for water and dust protection. It has a thin, lightweight body with a symmetrical curved design. Operating system: Ships with Motorola's Hello UI based on Android 14. The company has promised three years of OS updates and four years of security updates. Audio: Stereo speakers with Dolby Atmos support. Connectivity: 5G, Wi-Fi 5 (ac), Bluetooth 5.2, and NFC. Security: Features an in-display fingerprint reader and face unlock
